_contract: The weekly screen's output surface (CPO_NEWSFEED_official-updates.md v1; wording rules in CMO_NEWSFEED_whitelist.md). CMO runs the screen, TM commits the result here. reviewed.date moves ONLY when a screen actually ran - a stamp is a claim. reviewed.sources names ONLY what that run actually screened; reviewed.pending names whitelist sources the run did NOT reach, so an unscreened source is stated, never quietly omitted. items[] carries source headlines VERBATIM with attribution and the canonical outbound url - never COVA commentary (that is v2, unruled). Screen record: nodes/working/TM_screen_<date>/SCREEN_RECORD.md.
